questions.question: What were Infosys' total revenues for fiscal 2024?
questions.evidence: The revenue table reports total revenue from operations of $18,562 million for the year ended March 31, 2024.

questions.question: How much did Infosys' revenue increase from fiscal 2023 to fiscal 2024, and what was the percentage growth?
questions.expected_answer: Revenue increased by $350 million, or 1.9%, from $18,212 million in fiscal 2023 to $18,562 million in fiscal 2024.
questions.evidence: The fiscal 2024 revenue growth table reports $18,562 million versus $18,212 million, a $350 million increase and 1.9% growth.

questions.question: What were Infosys' revenue amounts from software services and products and platforms in fiscal 2024?
questions.expected_answer: Software services revenue was $17,549 million and products and platforms revenue was $1,013 million.
questions.evidence: The revenue disaggregation table reports $17,549 million from software services and $1,013 million from products and platforms.

questions.question: What percentage of Infosys' total revenue came from products and platforms in fiscal 2024, and how did it compare with fiscal 2023?
questions.expected_answer: Products and platforms represented 5.5% of total revenues in fiscal 2024, down from 6.3% in fiscal 2023.
questions.evidence: The report states that products and platforms represented 5.5% of total revenues in fiscal 2024 and 6.3% in fiscal 2023.

questions.question: Which business segment contributed the largest percentage of Infosys' revenues in fiscal 2024?
questions.evidence: The fiscal 2024 business-segment table lists Financial Services at 27.4%, the highest segment share.

questions.question: Which geography accounted for the largest amount of Infosys' revenue in fiscal 2024?
questions.expected_answer: North America, with $11,163 million of revenue.
questions.evidence: The geography table reports North America at $11,163 million, ahead of Europe at $5,105 million, Rest of the world at $1,825 million, and India at $469 million.

questions.question: What were Infosys' onsite and offshore revenue percentages in fiscal 2024?
questions.expected_answer: Onsite revenue was 52.4% and offshore revenue was 47.6%.
questions.evidence: The report's location-based revenue table gives 52.4% onsite and 47.6% offshore for fiscal 2024.

questions.question: What were Infosys' utilization rates for billable IT services professionals in fiscal 2024, including and excluding trainees?
questions.evidence: The utilization table reports 80.7% including trainees and 82.2% excluding trainees for fiscal 2024.

questions.question: What were Infosys' operating margin, net margin, and profit before income taxes as percentages of revenue in fiscal 2024?
questions.expected_answer: Operating margin was 20.7%, net margin was 17.1%, and profit before income taxes was 23.4% of revenue.
questions.evidence: The financial-information-as-percentage-of-revenues table reports 20.7% operating margin, 17.1% net margin, and 23.4% profit before income taxes.

questions.question: What were Infosys' final and interim dividends per equity share recognized during fiscal 2024?
questions.expected_answer: The final dividend was ₹17.50 per equity share and the interim dividend was ₹18.00 per equity share.
questions.evidence: The dividend table lists an interim dividend of ₹18.00 and a final dividend of ₹17.50 for fiscal 2024.

questions.question: What final and special dividends did Infosys' Board recommend on April 18, 2024 for the year ended March 31, 2024?
questions.expected_answer: A final dividend of ₹20 per equity share and a special dividend of ₹8 per equity share were recommended, subject to shareholder approval.

questions.question: What was the aggregate value of Infosys' completely or partially unsatisfied performance obligations as of March 31, 2024, and what percentage was expected to be recognized within one year?
questions.expected_answer: $10,869 million, of which around 53% was expected to be recognized within the next one year.
